canon.note: Diagnostic Kick (121101): 100% single-target at L6. Singing Among Clouds (121102, Skill): heals a single ally (#1% Max HP + #2), then heals random allies #4 time(s), each subsequent heal reduced by #3%. Felicitous Thunderleap (121103, Ultimate): heals ALL allies (#1% Max HP + #2), applies Invigoration for #3 = 2 turns (extends by 1 if already Invigorated, cannot stack). Gourdful of Elixir (121104, Talent): heals the ally when Invigorated ally is hit (#5 triggers), and revives a teammate taking a killing blow (1x per battle; notes: does not trigger when Bailu herself is knocked down first or when CC'd). Qihuang Analects (Trace): overheal raises target Max HP +10% for 2 turns. Vidyadhara Ichor Lines: Invigoration +1 trigger. Aquatic Benediction: Invigorated allies take 10% less DMG.

Felicitous Thunderleap (121103) is Bailu's Ultimate action (2 casts in the fixture).
Singing Among Clouds (121102) is her Skill action (4 casts in the fixture).
Diagnostic Kick (121101) is her Basic ATK action (1 cast in the fixture).
Diagnostic Kick hits its single target once (1 cast).
Healing events on Bailu in the fixture: 14 (3 per Skill cast — 1 designated + 2 random bounces that land on Bailu when solo — across 4 casts, plus 1 per Ultimate cast × 2).
The Basic ATK regenerates 1 Skill Point (1 cast).
The Skill costs 1 Skill Point per cast (4 casts = 4 SP).
Diagnostic Kick at the engine's default Basic Lv6 (121101) totals 100% of ATK.
Over the fixture Bailu gains exactly 155 Energy (ENERGY_GAIN sum; both Ultimates consume their full gauge).
Invigoration (121103) lasts #3 = 2 turns (applied/extended by the Ultimates).
Aquatic Benediction (Trace: Invigorated allies take 10% less DMG) tracks Invigoration's 2-turn duration.
Bailu's first Ultimate cast comes after her first Skill cast (110 Energy must build first).
